issues.description: Farm constructor signature is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement requires a no-argument Farm() constructor that initializes the animals list with a new ArrayList, and the provided Main/template example constructs a farm via new Farm(). The solution instead only provides Farm(int initialCapacity), so code following the specification/template (new Farm()) would not compile against the solution design.
issues.suggestedFix: Add the required no-argument constructor to Farm in the solution: `public Farm() { this.animals = new ArrayList<>(); }`. If keeping `Farm(int initialCapacity)` as an overload, ensure both constructors initialize `animals`.
